description: Hold some of a month's unassigned money so it carries into the next month, instead of assigning it now. Adds to whatever is already held; pass 0 to release it all. To give money to a category, or to take it back, use transfer_between_categories; this one assigns nothing, it only keeps what is left over from being assigned this month.

amount.description: How much to hold, added to what is already held (human-readable, e.g. 150.00). Pass 0 to release the whole hold.

month.description: Month (YYYY-MM or natural language). Defaults to the current month.

name: hold_for_next_month
